title: Le Magnifique
writer: Philippe de Broca, Vittorio Caprioli, Jean-Paul Rappeneau
actors: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Jacqueline Bisset, Vittorio Caprioli
plot: Writing his 43rd spy novel, François includes people from his life. He's the competent, sophisticated secret agent Bob in stark contrast to François. His cute neighbor is Tatiana who helps Bob in Acapulco.
